description.narrative: The most significant expected project-level outcome is improved access to finance for MSMEs, including WMSMEs, through Fintechs in the Asia Pacific (APAC) region. Beyond project-level outcomes, IFC anticipates that the financing through this Project will promote competitiveness in the debt financing market for Fintechs in APAC through demonstration and replication channels.

The project is a senior debt investment of up-to US$25 million in an up-to US$50 million senior tranche to be issued by Helicap Income Opportunities Fund (HIOF or the Fund). Launched in 2019, HIOF is an open-ended private credit fund based in Singapore that provides senior secured loans to fintech-based FIs and digital lenders in Asia Pacific to support on-lending to MSMEs and micro borrowers.
